perde:10.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells of the mountain called the Little Dragon near Erzurum, where the Lamplighters dared to shine their lanterns on a sleeping dragon's face. He tells it with mounting dread, as an old man who knows what angry mountains do; the tension coils tighter and tighter until the mountain breathes and the snow comes down. Then, out of the white roar, a blue-maned wolf runs ahead, and the dread breaks into fierce, breathless awe.

oyun.823c9063: Ominous and scornful: the Lamplighters' arrogance. 'Küçük Ejder' named with respect, almost fear; 'fenerlerini dağın burnuna tuttu' slow and contemptuous, as if they poked a sleeping beast.
oyun.4a32785a: A warning from the old ones, low and grave. 'Uyuyan ejder ışığı sevmez' like a curse. Pause. 'Ejder uyurken dağ susar' hushed; then 'uyandığında kar akar' dark, heavy, inevitable.
oyun.767212df: A heavy, slow breath of the mountain itself: 'Dağ' weighty, 'derin bir nefes aldı' long and low, ending in silence.
oyun.a29f2395: The blow falls. 'Ve...' a held beat, then 'kar aktı' dropped heavy and hard, like thunder rolling down the slope. Short, crushing, final.
oyun.905d2ffc: Out of the avalanche, sudden fierce wonder. Rush the first half with speed and excitement, 'gök yeleli kurt' lifted with awe; then 'güvenli yolu o biliyordu' warm, firm, full of trust.

perde:11.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how Saye came down from the snows into Cappadocia, the land of beautiful horses, where wind carved giants out of ash and shepherds saw fairy lights on the chimneys. He is full of enchantment and old-world wonder, smiling like a grandfather telling a fairy tale; but at the end the smile fades and his voice darkens, warning of the red shadow, Albasti, that steals the light.

oyun.b639eda7: Relief after the storm, then quiet arrival. 'Çığ dindiğinde' an exhale; 'Kapadokya'ya indi' open and wide; 'Muşkara köyünün üstünde ay doğuyordu' slow, silvery, full of night beauty.
oyun.4d6ab796: Proud, epic wonder at an ancient land. 'Katpatuka' savoured; 'güzel atlar ülkesi' warm. Build the grandeur: 'rüzgâr bin yıl oydu' weighty; 'başlıklı devler gibi göğe yükseldi' rising, majestic.
oyun.96686b28: A fireside fairy tale, hushed and twinkling. 'tepelerde ışıklar' secretive; 'Periler, derlerdi' with a knowing smile; 'devlerle savaşmış periler' rising with playful, mysterious excitement.
oyun.cf3de038: Speak straight to Saye, tender and intimate, almost a secret. 'Peri halkı gölge bırakmaz, Sâye.' Pause. 'Ama gölgeyi tanır' soft, reassuring, a small comfort.
oyun.d83880eb: The smile drops; sudden menace. 'kızıl bir gölge' low and creeping; pause; 'Albastı' hissed with dread. 'Işığı çalar' cold. Then 'demirden korkar' sharper, a whispered weapon handed to the child.

perde:12.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how Saye saw the Lamplighters' lanterns sinking one by one into a well-mouth in the plain: Derinkuyu, a city eight floors under the earth, built over the sleep of fire giants. His voice moves from discovery to deep, claustrophobic awe, then to a hushed, urgent warning; at the end, a muffled sound from the very bottom brings real fear.

oyun.e59b00f0: Tense discovery from a height. 'birer birer içine iniyordu' slow, counting the lanterns with dread; pause; 'Derinkuyu' named low and ominous, like the name of a pit.
oyun.a60843d2: Astonishment, growing as the list descends. 'sekiz kat' heavy; build 'ahırları, şaraphaneleri, şapelleri, kuyuları' step by step; 'yirmi bin can' with awe and pity for those who hid in fear.
oyun.1d5e1474: A dark legend told low. 'ateşli devleri' with menace; 'yerin altına sürmüştü' pushed down. Then 'devlerin uykusunun üstüne bir şehir' slow, uneasy: the danger sleeping beneath every step.
oyun.c331d2a8: Grave counsel, firm then urgent. 'yalnızca içeriden açılır' weighty; 'İçeride olan yaşar' stark. 'Aşağı in, Sâye' a command; pause; 'ama uyuyanı uyandırma' a fearful whisper.
oyun.9cae3fd1: Real fear. 'boğuk bir ses' dropped low and muffled, as if listening. Pause. 'Erlik'in katı' with dread; 'oradan da aşağıdadır' sinking, almost swallowed by the dark.

perde:13.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how the winged horse Tulpar set Saye down on a moonlit, snowy plain, and far to the west the domes of Konya were shining: the city where the Lamplighters had taken his master, on the very night of Seb-i Arus, Mevlana's wedding night. His voice carries longing, reverence and a trembling hope, then a cold anger at the Lamplighters' plan; it ends on a still, watchful image of the blue-maned wolf looking down at the city.

oyun.deb43b9d: Wide and breathless, a long journey ending. 'bulutların arasından indirdiğinde' descending; 'gökte ay vardı' hushed; 'uçsuz bucaksız, karlı bir ova' slow, vast, lonely.
oyun.5b77a2b8: Hope and longing, the heart quickening. 'kubbeleri parlıyordu' with wonder. Pause. 'ustayı oraya götürmüştü' aching; then rise with reverence: 'Konya'ya', 'Mevlânâ'nın şehrine' tender and holy.
oyun.565e96da: Solemn, a date that matters. 'on yedi Aralık'tı' slow and deliberate. Pause. 'Şeb-i Arûs' with deep reverence; 'düğün gecesi' warm and quiet, a mystery smiled at.
oyun.e7c3bced: Grief turned into joy. 'Mevlânâ ölmüştü' low and heavy. Then lift the quote with love and serenity: 'Ağlamayın' tender; 'bu benim düğünümdür' luminous, the voice almost smiling through tears.
oyun.8efb6f63: Cold anger and contempt for a terrible plan. 'düğün gecesinde ışık ölmez' mocking their belief; 'sonsuza dek yakmak için' slow and menacing; 'bu geceyi bekliyorlardı' dark, a trap waiting.
oyun.8a5fed46: Stillness and quiet strength. Slow, hushed, like a painted scene. 'gök yeleli bir kurt' with protective awe; 'şehre bakıyordu' held, watchful, full of unspoken promise.

perde:14.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how Saye slid down through the roots of the Tree of Life to the deepest bottom of the world, where there was only the sound of water; and he sings the old bard's creation tale of Kayra Han, Ak Ana and the proud Erlik cast under the earth. His voice turns ancient and cosmic, full of primordial awe, then darkens into fear as he reveals that the stolen lights, and his own master, were carried down to Erlik's realm, where the Kormos keep stolen souls in cages.

oyun.23e4aa9d: Descent into mystery. 'yerin en dibine iner' sinking low; 'süzüldü' soft and slow. Pause before the reveal; 'su sesi' whispered with awe, as if hearing it now.
oyun.2c4ebfd8: The old bard's saying: chant it, ancient and cosmic. 'Başlangıçta yalnız su vardı' slow, vast, timeless. Pause. 'yalnızdı' lonely; 'ne yaratacağını bilmiyordu' hushed, full of primordial wonder.
oyun.c5fb2ddf: Sacred wonder. 'Sudan ak bir ana yükseldi' rising; 'Ak Ana' named with reverence. '"Yarat"' a single, powerful command; then 'yeniden suya döndü' soft and vanishing.
oyun.483b065e: First pride, then betrayal. 'Kayra Han yarattı' broad and proud. 'Ama' darkening; 'Erlik' with dread; 'kendini ondan büyük sandı' bitter; 'yerin altına sürüldü' heavy, cast down.
oyun.3f5d38e6: Dread becomes personal grief. 'Erlik'in katına akıyordu' ominous, flowing down. Long pause. 'Usta da o yoldan geçirilmişti' the voice breaking, quiet and wounded.
oyun.0c410c6e: The old bard's saying: a hero's legend, brave and kindling hope. 'Er Töştük' proud; 'yerin altına düşmüştü' grave; 'Çalkuyruk' warm and fond; 'yol gösterdi' a promise.
oyun.77791af8: Creeping fear. 'Erlik'in gölgeleri dolaşır' low, slithering; pause; 'Körmösler' hissed. 'Işığa gelirler' a warning; 'kafeslerde tutarlar' cold and pitiful, the horror of caged souls.

perde:15.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali sings the old bard's tale of Ergenekon: the defeated ancestors who hid in a hidden valley for four hundred years until the valley grew too small, and how a blacksmith melted the iron mountain with seventy bellows. He begins in sorrow and defeat, grows through patience and stubborn resolve into a roaring, triumphant climax as the mountain melts; then, with sudden heaviness, he reveals the Lamplighters have stolen the forge's fire, and turns to Saye with a challenge.

oyun.02c1dbe0: The old bard's saying: open in grief and defeat. 'büyük bir savaşta yenildi' heavy, mourning. Pause. 'yalnız iki yiğit' a thin thread of hope; 'Kıyan ile Nüküz' named with honour.
oyun.daa58944: Hushed refuge, then relief. 'bir keçi yolundan dar' narrow and tense; pause; 'Ergenekon' reverent. Open into warmth and plenty: 'çayır, ırmak, meyve ağacı ve av' growing abundant.
oyun.ef6645ec: Time and pressure. 'Dört yüz yıl geçti' slow and long. 'vadi dar geldi' tightening. 'Ama' pause; 'dışarı çıkacak yol yoktu' despairing; 'aşılmaz dağ' hard, a wall.
oyun.be57bbb7: Defiance and resolve. The blacksmith's words bold and rough: 'Şu dağ demirdir' a revelation; 'eritelim' fierce. Then 'yetmiş körük' with pride and swelling energy.
oyun.7f549046: The triumphant climax: 'Dağ eridi' loud, roaring, victorious. 'yol açıldı' free, joyful. Then soften to mystery: 'bir boz kurdun gösterdiğini' hushed, with awe.
oyun.e1169454: Pride and ritual. 'kutsal sayıldı' solemn. Make the forging rhythmic and strong: 'ateşte kızdırılır', 'örsün üstünde dövülürdü' like hammer blows, proud and ringing.
oyun.02d48916: Sudden heaviness and anger. 'ateşi de toplamıştı' bitter. Pause. 'Ocak sönük, Sâye' quiet and grieving; then 'körükler bekliyor' rising, a challenge and a call to the child.

perde:16.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali sings the old bard's tale of the shamans of Altai, whose drums lift souls up through the layered heavens: Ulgen enthroned on the highest, the cold moon, the stars wheeling round the Iron Stake, the horse-thieves and the Wind Mother. His voice soars with ecstatic, cosmic wonder, a vision unfolding layer by layer; at the end it hardens with purpose, as Saye rises above the clouds to chase the stolen piece of the broken sun.

oyun.73a61eee: The old bard's saying: trance-like and rhythmic, like a drum beginning. 'davullarını çalınca' pulsing; 'canları göğe yükselirmiş' lifting with wonder; 'kat kat' savoured, opening a vision.
oyun.7cee4ae8: Soaring reverence. 'En yüksek katta Ülgen oturur' grand and luminous; 'iyiliğin ve aydınlığın kaynağı' warm, radiant. Pause. 'Erlik onun karşıtıdır' darker, low, a shadow.
oyun.9d787973: Dreamlike wonder, slow and starry. 'ay soğuk ve yumuşak yanar' hushed, silvery; then a turning motion: 'yıldızlar Demir Kazık'ın çevresinde döner', 'Demir Kazık' stressed, majestic.
oyun.9eb0d47d: A sky-legend with a thrill of danger. 'iki at bağlıdır' tender; 'Yedi Karakçı' sly and menacing; 'çalmak ister' tense. Then 'Yel Ana eser' airy, a sweeping breath.
oyun.14a471a1: Anger, then rising courage. 'kırık güneşin bir parçasını' bitter; 'en yüksek katına götürmüştü' grim. Pause. 'Bir kam davulunu çaldı' strong and rhythmic; 'bulutların üstüne yükseldi' soaring, exultant.

perde:17.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how a root pulled Saye up from the bottom of Derinkuyu into the dawn of Otuken, the holy forest of the ancestors, where the Tree of Life reaches the sky and Umay keeps the souls of unborn children. He begins in relief and radiant joy, proudly quoting the ancient Kul Tigin inscription; then his voice drops cold with horror as he reveals that Karabasan, the nightmare that devours masterless shadows, has followed her up; at the end he grasps for protective hope in every ray of light.

oyun.564a7fe2: Out of darkness toward hope. 'en dibinde' low and close; 'kökler sarkıyordu' wondering. Then lift steadily with relief: 'yukarı, ışığa doğru çekti' rising, the voice brightening.
oyun.f09c2d70: Radiant relief and joy. 'gün ağarıyordu' breathing open. Pause. 'uçsuz bucaksız bir orman' wide and glad; 'kayınlar, çamlar, yosun, kuş sesi' savoured one by one, alive.
oyun.63c8be5e: Proud and solemn, like reading words carved in stone. 'Kül Tigin Yazıtı der ki' grave; 'Ötüken ormanıdır' with ancestral pride; 'ondan iyisi yoktur' firm, unshakable.
oyun.d4bfc68b: Sacred awe and tenderness. 'göğe dek yükselir' rising; 'Hayat Ağacı' reverent. 'Umay' warm as a mother's name; 'kuş olup konar' soft, wondering, a lullaby.
oyun.8af84528: The joy freezes. 'Ama Sâye yalnız değildi' low and chilling. Build the dread: 'ilk gören', 'ardından sürünen' creeping. Long pause. 'Karabasan' whispered with true fear.
oyun.886cb46b: Cold horror, slow and close. 'sahipsiz gölgeleri sezer' sinister; 'göğsüne çöker' heavy, crushing; 'onları yer' stark. Last sentence with grief: 'en tatlı lokmadır' bitter and pitying.
oyun.71fd8fbe: Fierce, protective hope. 'Ama ışığa giremez' firm, almost defiant. Then warm and loving: 'süzülen her huzme' bright; 'bir sığınaktır' a blessing over the child.

perde:18.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells how the Wind Mother left Saye on the threshold of the Sun's Layer, where the shaman's drum could no longer be heard, and Ulgen's gate waited beyond with the piece of the broken sun. His voice holds loneliness and awe at that terrible height, then growing tension as Erlik's storm boils even there; he reaches for the old legends of Huma and Tulpar like charms of good fortune, and ends with thunder rolling and the sky's anger at its full.

oyun.8b897456: Lonely and exposed. 'gün katının eşiğine bıraktı' slow, a farewell. Pause. 'Kam'ın davulu artık duyulmuyordu' hushed and uneasy, the silence frightening.
oyun.4498239c: Awe and longing. 'Ülgen'in kapısı' reverent and grand; 'kırık güneşin parçası' with ache; 'orada bekliyordu' slow, hopeful, a goal within sight.
oyun.37e842ab: Searing heat, then menace. 'güneş yakar' bright and hard. 'Ama' pause; 'bu yüksekliğinde bile' disbelief; 'Erlik'in fırtınası kaynıyordu' dark, seething, threatening.
oyun.f103e512: Old legends offered like charms against fear. 'Hüma'nın gölgesi' with wonder; 'kut getirir' warm, blessing. 'Tulpar' proud; 'göğün katları arasında taşır' soaring, full of hope.
oyun.c023fcf7: Mythic power. 'Süge Toyon'un sesi' grand and booming; 'kötü ruhlara indirir' fierce, a strike. Pause. 'O gece gök gürlüyordu' low, rumbling, ominous, the storm at its height.

epilogue.sahne: Late at night, behind the lamp-lit screen, the very old master Hayali tells the last scene: Konya, the night of Seb-i Arus, a trembling lamp on the Green Dome under the snow, and his own beloved master, old and shrunken, ringed by the Lamplighters. When the master speaks, the old man gives him a frail, loving voice and his own voice keeps breaking with tears. It is the deepest grief of the tale: the master gives his lamp to Saye, the lamp goes out, the screen goes dark. Then wonder: the shadow has not vanished but become light, the Lamplighters weep over their returned shadows, and the night ends in tearful, radiant hope that the road goes on.

oyun.e74d8efd: Hushed, almost reverent, holding the breath. 'Yeşil Kubbe'nin tepesinde' slow; 'karın altında' soft; pause; 'bir kandil titriyordu' a trembling whisper, fragile as the flame.
oyun.a9001d42: The heart breaks at the sight. 'Ustası oradaydı' a choked rush of love. Pause. 'yaşlanmış, küçülmüştü' broken, tender, near tears. Then colder: 'halka olmuş' menacing, the lanterns closing in.
oyun.d8d777ec: The master's voice: frail, warm, full of love and unshaken faith. '"Geldin"' a soft, wondering breath of joy; 'Biliyordum' tender; 'Dua karşılıksız kalmaz' slow, a blessing.
oyun.4753fc9d: Grave revelation with pity, not hatred. 'gölgelerini kaybetmişlerdi' sorrowful; 'tek ışıktı' weighty. 'güneş kırılmıştı' heavy; 'yeniden yakacaklardı' dark and tense, the danger complete.
oyun.be9d7112: The master speaks, quiet and knowing, with a sad smile. 'Kandilim sönmesin diye' weary; pause; 'Mevlânâ'nın düğün gecesine' tender, reverent; 'ışık ölmez' with sorrowful irony at their hope.
oyun.ebe6aaa1: The master, serene and luminous. 'Haklılar, Sâye' slow. 'Bu gece ışık ölmez' firm. Long pause. 'Yalnızca kavuşur' whispered with deep peace and love, the voice trembling.
oyun.5c891b84: The ney rises: aching and sacred. 'ney sesi yükseldi' lifting, mournful. Pause. 'kandili Sâye'nin avuçlarına bıraktı' slow and tender, the voice nearly breaking at the farewell.
oyun.cd6f67f2: The master's last words, full of love, through tears. 'Sen benim gölgem değildin' pause; 'Duamdın' a broken whisper. Build 'Hem eşim, hem yolum, hem hemzatım'; 'ışığı tutma sırası sende' brave.
oyun.e1c6a46b: The deepest grief. Barely spoken, voice cracking: 'Kandil... söndü.' Let it fall into silence. No drama, only loss.
oyun.5dbec68f: Hollow emptiness. 'Perde karardı' quiet and dark. Long pause. 'Bir an hiçbir şey kalmadı' a whisper; 'ne usta, ne gölge' slow, grieving, each word an empty space.
oyun.3183033a: From darkness, sudden wonder. 'Sonra' a breath; 'bir ışık doğdu' rising with awe. 'Gölge kaybolmamıştı' firm, tears turning to joy; 'ışığa karışmıştı' radiant, almost singing.
oyun.9ac76efc: Triumphant, overwhelming release. 'bütün ışık' swelling; 'göğe yükseldi' soaring. Then slow and tender with pity: 'gölgelerine baktı' hushed; 've ağladı' broken, forgiving, full of compassion.
oyun.460eee92: Hudhud's voice, bright and urgent, stirring hope. 'yalnızca bir parçası' a reveal; pause; 'dünyanın dört bir yanına dağıldı' widening, rising, the call of a new adventure.
oyun.db2c550f: Tearful hope, looking forward. 'perdenin ardına baktı' slow, wondering. 'Kar yeni yağmış gibi' soft and pure; 'önünde bir yol uzanıyordu' opening wide, full of promise.
oyun.3c0afa4d: The final farewell, tender and strong. 'Rüzgârda ustasının sesi' hushed, a memory. Then the master's voice: 'Yürü, Sâye' warm, a blessing. Pause. 'Yol bitmez' firm; 'yürüyen değişir' slow, wise, the last word lingering.
